Timothy Stephens
Curriculum vitae

Personal summary

I am a computational biologist working on understanding and characterizing functionally uncharacterized “dark genes”, which are found in all non-model genomes, but often ignored despite their immense biological importance. I am also CTO of OceanOmics, a company dedicated to developing scalable tools for environmental health monitoring.
